    - region "GLP-1 Tracker":
      - 'heading "GLP-1 Tracker: at a glance" [level=2]'
      - paragraph: Wave 14 · week of Oct 19, 2026 · compared with previous wave (Sep 21, 2026) · last year = closest wave a year earlier (wave 3, Oct 20, 2025) · data as of 2026-10-21
      - text: "Using a GLP-1 drug 15.2% ▼ 3.5 pts vs LY ▼ 2.3 pts vs previous wave Taking it for weight loss 73.8% ▼ 3.6 pts vs LY ▼ 9.3 pts vs previous wave Eating less 52.5% ▲ 8.5 pts vs LY ▲ 15.8 pts vs previous wave #1 change since starting I appreciate eating healthier foods more 50.8% of users · last year 40.0% ▲ 10.8 pts vs LY ▲ 17.0 pts vs previous wave"
      - heading "Key takeaways" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Written from the numbers above, so they can never disagree with them
      - list:
        - listitem: "Usage: 15% of US adults are using a GLP-1 drug like Ozempic (19% a year ago); 74% of users take it for weight loss (77% a year ago)."
        - listitem: "Eating: 52% of users eat less than before (44% a year ago)."
        - listitem: "Since starting: I appreciate eating healthier foods more (51%), I am dining out less frequently (43%), I have been drinking less alcohol (43%) are the top changes among users (n=61). Biggest significant move vs the previous wave: I appreciate eating healthier foods more (+17.0 pts)."
        - listitem: "How they eat less: I am eating smaller portion sizes than I was before (64%), I changed how often I eat meals (44%), I am consuming less types of certain foods (41%) lead among users eating less (n=61)."
        - listitem: "By generation, using a GLP-1 drug: GenZ 18%, Millennial 20%, GenX 15%, Boomer 9% (all adults: 15%). Millennial leads and Boomer trails, a significant gap of 10 pts. Small base: GenZ."
